method: The new session-summary variant uses unweighted session-feature means in real, context and permuted arms. Whole prompts, ordered by first timestamp within writer, alternate between disjoint halves. In three frozen writer-role rotations, independent donor writers supply same-prompt context means; each writer is a probe once. One common writer-label assignment is shuffled within prompt and role fold for each of 1,000 draws and reused across rotations. Accepted-share nuisance coefficients are fit using gallery sessions only and refit in every null draw. The pass rule is one-sided empirical p<0.05 and a positive lower bound for the 2,000-draw paired probe-writer 95% interval. Page routes additionally require both raw and residualized variants to pass.

scope: Human CoAuthor source records and mixed human/model final documents; exact nearest-neighbour program over frozen features. All 1,399 original sessions and 990 genre-matched sessions are retained. Identification probes retain 45 eligible writers, each tested once against a fixed 30-writer gallery. Genre probes retain all 24 writers, each tested once against 16. The estimates are descriptive and conditional on those galleries and features; intervals resample probe writers, not galleries. No psychological automaticity, causal mechanism, private preference or general population identification claim follows.
